target: Prove that no same-cut double-bridge pair becomes co-eligible in a frozen exact key by a temporal K-to-R-to-P-to-B-to-K-prime induction.

stage_model.K: exact entry key after pre-unit closure
stage_model.B: raw child after the selected branch and before child pre-units
stage_model.K_prime: reached child exact key after child pre-units

falsified_hypotheses.name: Raw same-cut noncreation
falsified_hypotheses.reason: Two same-cut pairs occur in raw frozen-pass outputs through GT_8.

falsified_hypotheses.name: 553 post-unit pair births
falsified_hypotheses.reason: The extra pairs are local Resolution outputs; post-units create zero pairs on the finite GT frontier.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Pure contraction same-cut noncreation
falsified_hypotheses.reason: Complete abstract gates find same-cut births.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Two branch-safe sources cannot create a same-cut pair
falsified_hypotheses.reason: A two-step four-vertex gate finds 2592 branch-safe non-unit births through directed-cycle shield collapse.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Component-pair frequency factorization
falsified_hypotheses.reason: 1133 of 1851 component-pair groups and 463 of 604 selected groups are nonuniform through GT_8.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Nonroot unshielded P-occurrences are absent
falsified_hypotheses.reason: Three occur in one GT_8 depth-two state, but all hand off safely.

falsified_hypotheses.name: Every safe root branch must touch a bad endpoint
falsified_hypotheses.reason: Thirteen disjoint root selections occur through GT_12; all destroy bridgehood rather than producing unsafe descendants.

proved_theorems.name: Frozen Fresh-Side Barrier
proved_theorems.statement: Every same-cut pair first appearing in a frozen output R=K union F contains a fresh side and cannot be co-eligible in its birth pass.

proved_theorems.name: Post-Unit Total-Component Collapse Barrier
proved_theorems.statement: The first component-merging post-unit can occur only with two quotient components and collapses them to one, leaving no bridge cut.

proved_theorems.name: Branch-Handoff Same-Cut Route Classification
proved_theorems.statement: Inherited pairs require common-cut preservation; new pairs require directed-cycle shield collapse and two complementary identical-cut bridge exposures.

proved_theorems.name: Two-Node Tail-Wing Handoff
proved_theorems.statement: If a bad bridge cuts off a two-node tail wing and the selected clause literal is its unique internal edge, one polarity deletes the clause and the other contracts the wing to tail-singleton safety.

remaining_local_obligations.name: Root Endpoint-or-Shield-or-Destruction
remaining_local_obligations.statement: Every root unshielded occurrence becomes extinct, non-bridge, tail-singleton safe, or canonically N_a-shielded under each selected branch polarity.

remaining_local_obligations.name: Non-Root Wing Reachability
remaining_local_obligations.statement: Every reachable non-root unshielded P-occurrence is already safe or satisfies the proved two-node tail-wing hypotheses.

remaining_local_obligations.name: T3 Temporal Exact-Key Induction
remaining_local_obligations.statement: T0 plus T1, T2a, and completed T2b preserve same-cut absence through every K-to-R-to-P-to-B-to-K-prime transition.

claim_boundary: T1, T2a, the pure branch routes, and the two-node tail-wing implication are proved under explicit hypotheses. Root-route and non-root wing reachability for arbitrary n, T3, the global cache lower bound, and P versus NP remain open.
